title: Before Attention Sinks Form: Hidden-State Geometry Reveals and Modulates Their Formation
abstract: arXiv:2610.16745v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention sinks are usually studied after they have formed. We ask whether a measurable hidden-state change appears beforehand and whether changing that geometry alters what happens later. To remove network depth as a shortcut, we compare prompts in the same model and at the same layer. When sink timing varies across prompts, simple spectral summaries of the hidden states add information beyond current attention, with the clearest prompt-specific signal in a short window about two to three layers before sink formation. The predictive strength varies across cohorts, so we treat the spectrum as a readout of a pre-sink state change rather than a universal warning statistic. The signal is broader than one measured extreme activation. We then modify only the singular values of the post-layer hidden states after current attention has already been computed. These interventions change later sink behavior in Qwen2.5, GLM-Z1, and GPT-OSS relativ

translated_title: 在注意力汇形成之前：隐藏状态几何结构揭示并调节其形成
translated_abstract: 注意力汇通常是在形成之后才被研究的。我们探究在注意力汇形成之前是否会出现可测量的隐藏状态变化，以及改变这种几何结构是否会改变随后发生的事情。为了排除网络深度这一捷径，我们在同一模型和同一层上比较不同的提示词。当注意力汇的形成时机在不同提示词之间存在差异时，隐藏状态的简单谱摘要能够提供超越当前注意力之外的信息，其中最清晰的特定提示词信号出现在注意力汇形成前约两到三层的短窗口内。由于预测强度在不同群组间存在差异，我们将频谱视为汇前状态变化的一种读出信号，而非一种通用的预警统计量。该信号比某个被测量的极端激活更为广泛。随后，我们仅在当前注意力已经计算完成之后，修改层后隐藏状态的奇异值。这些干预改变了 Qwen2.5、GLM-Z1 和 GPT-OSS 中后续的注意力汇行为。
tldr: 该论文发现隐藏状态的谱特征可在注意力汇形成前两到三层的短窗口内提前预测其形成，并证明仅修改隐藏状态的奇异值即可干预和调节后续的注意力汇行为。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that spectral summaries of hidden states can predict attention sink formation two to three layers in advance, and that modifying only the singular values of hidden states can modulate subsequent attention sink behavior.
